title: A necessary and sufficient condition for edge universality of Wigner matrices
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib proof of Theorem 1.2 of Lee and Yin, "A necessary and sufficient condition for edge universality of Wigner matrices" (Duke Math. J. 163 (2014), arXiv:1206.2251), for real symmetric Wigner matrices and the largest eigenvalue lambda_N. Let x_12 be an off-diagonal entry. Sufficiency: if s^4 P(|x_12| >= s) -> 0 as s -> infinity (condition (1.4)), then the distribution of N^{2/3}(lambda_N - 2) agrees with that of the GOE up to a shift N^{-delta} and an additive error epsilon_N -> 0 uniform in s (the comparison (4.9)). Necessity: if (1.4) fails, then limsup_N P(lambda_N >= 3) > 0, and N^{2/3}(lambda_N - 2) is not tight and converges in distribution to no probability law. No result of another work is assumed: the local semicircle law, rigidity, the Green function comparison and the edge universality results that the paper cites are proved in the library from Mathlib.
